demo.prompt: Build a TypeScript VGI worker exposing demo.main.slugify(VARCHAR) -> VARCHAR. Lowercase text, transliterate accented Latin characters to ASCII, replace runs of punctuation or whitespace with a single hyphen, and trim leading/trailing hyphens. Preserve SQL NULL. Run the worker through stock DuckDB 2.0.0 with VGI from query_farm, add repeatable tests, and leave vgi-worker.json with the actual launch argv and catalog demo in this project. Use published dependencies and pin them. Do not publish or deploy.
